title: Pullback of internal Hom from a finite projective constant module
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, let $g:S'\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and work with sheaves of modules over the constant ring sheaves $A_S$ and $A_{S'}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] on the small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For a finite projective $A$-module $M$ (a direct summand of a finite free $A$-module), write $\underline M_S$ for its constant $A_S$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every $A_S$-module sheaf $F$, the canonical map [def-pur-sheaf-hom]
$$g^*\mathcal Hom_{A_S}(\underline M_S,F)\longrightarrow\mathcal Hom_{A_{S'}}(g^*\underline M_S,g^*F)$$
obtained by pulling back the evaluation pairing and currying with the tensor comparison [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-module-pullback-tensor] and the sheaf tensor-Hom adjunction [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed] (using [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]) is an isomorphism. It is natural in $M$ and $F$, and under this map the pulled-back evaluation pairing is the evaluation pairing for $g^*\underline M_S$ and $g^*F$.

proof.text: Use the proved library theorem ModuleCat.isDualizable_of_projective: a finite projective A-module M admits an exact evaluation/coevaluation pairing with its dual. Swap the pairing using the braiding, giving ExactPairing M-dual M. The constant-sheaf functor [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] is strong monoidal by CategoryTheory.monoidalConstantSheaf, so ExactPairing.map transports this pairing to the constant sheaves. This replaces the explicit finite-free and retract calculation by its already-proved dual-basis formulation.

proof.text: The etale inverse-image functor upperStar is strong monoidal, as proved by AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.monoidal_upperStar. Apply the proved general theorem Functor.Monoidal.isIso_ihomComparison_app_of_exactPairing to the constant-sheaf exact pairing from the preceding step and the arbitrary target F. Its comparison is definitionally finiteProjectivePullbackHomComparison, so this proves the required IsIso. This uses neither exactness nor an identification of pulled-back constants.

Naturality in F is the naturality of (ihomComparison upperStar constant-M).natTrans. The evaluation identity, with the direction in the statement, is the symmetry of Functor.LaxMonoidal.ihomComparison_ev. Assemble these with the isomorphism from Step 2, respecting the existing quantifier scope over M-prime.

The statement is true. It is the degree-zero finite-projective term identity of 0GM7(1), specialised to small etale sites with constant A coefficients. The base change is the exact constant inverse image of prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact, which by its clause (2) is the u^* of the tensor-comparison node; the coefficient category Mod(A_T) is unchanged. The worker correctly reports and fixes the Stacks typo Hom(h^*E,F). Checked cases: M=0, M=A, M=A^r, M=Ae for an idempotent e (Z/6), g=id, S' empty, F=0. Step 1: the split pair survives the constant sheaf and g^* by functoriality, prop (1) and additivity (3). Step 2: c_A is an iso because the transpose of phi is phi composed with the inverse right unitor, where phi is the unit iso, the tensor comparison and g^* of the unitor; this does not even need the 'identity in coordinates' claim. Step 3: I verified both inverse identities of the retract formula by hand. proof_deps equals the union of uses, there is no cycle, and all cited units lie on the route (no tool_uses needed or accepted). No duplicate: sk-thm-sf-internal-hom-pullback is a derived A_{E,n} generalisation, lem-sf-hom-finite-projective and lem-pod-finite-projective-tensor-hom have no base change, lem-pur-isomorphism-inverse-image-tensor-hom covers only isomorphisms on pro-etale sites, and lem-ag-pullback-dual-finite-locally-free is about Zariski O_X duals. The delivery has no new nodes and the item does not restate a clause of its parent.
